case_name: D3: Rewrite for audience (legal → plain English)
instruction: Rewrite the 'Closing Conditions' section in plain English that a non-lawyer can understand. Keep the same substance — all 5 conditions should still be present — but remove legal jargon like 'HSR clearance' (explain it as 'government antitrust approval'), 'material adverse change' (explain as 'no significant negative changes to the business'), etc.
